topic.angle: US banks no longer have to hold a fraction of deposits in reserve

card.title: Banks no longer have to keep a reserve

body.claim: Since March 2020, US banks have not been required to hold any fraction of their customers' deposits in reserve.
body.why: The Federal Reserve cut its reserve requirement ratios to zero percent, effective 26 March 2020. Before that, larger banks had to hold up to 10% of certain deposits in reserve.

probes.question: True or false: US banks are currently required to hold 10% of deposits in reserve.

sources.title: Federal Reserve Board: press release, 15 March 2020
